basic_profile.bio: A seasoned Redditor with a love for all things space and technology. Originally from Morgantown, WV, but now residing in the bustling city of Seattle. By day, a software engineer working remotely for a tech startup. Passionate about aviation and often found discussing sci-fi lore and interstellar species on subreddits like MawInstallation. Enjoys exploring new technology and staying updated with domain names through NameCheap. Typically online during late evenings and weekends. In a long-term relationship with a fellow tech enthusiast.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a degree in Computer Science from a local university. Developed an interest in aviation through private pilot training and extended this passion into understanding space and interstellar species. Self-taught in various programming languages and consistently updates knowledge through online courses and community forums.
